title: How the Fruit Fly Mushroom Body Can Help Autonomous Materials Discovery: Learning to Stop, Dose and End Runs from a Few Examples at One Default Setting, in Simulation
description: Code and result files for the preprint "How the Fruit Fly Mushroom Body Can Help Autonomous Materials Discovery: Learning to Stop, Dose and End Runs from a Few Examples at One Default Setting, in Simulation".
